Fueling Deicing

السائل الثاني

A protective de-icing or anti-icing fluid applied after first fluid, designed to prevent further accumulation of ice or snow on aircraft surfaces.

Quick answer: A protective de-icing or anti-icing fluid applied after first fluid, designed to prevent further accumulation of ice or snow on aircraft surfaces.

Definition

A protective de-icing or anti-icing fluid applied after first fluid, designed to prevent further accumulation of ice or snow on aircraft surfaces.

Operational example

Ground, apply second fluid evenly after removal of contaminants with first fluid as per winter operations protocol.
